deploy-bot: Scheduled traffic shift for release v2.14.0 to GREEN pool starting now (change window: 30m). Plan: staged weight ramp 0->5->25->60->100 at ~5m intervals. Targets: router-edge-prod, router-eu-west. Rollback conditions: p95 latency +20% OR 5xx rate >1% over 2 consecutive minutes. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.14.0 — model-serving runtime update, KV cache noop-safe, no schema changes. Run: `./routerctl shift --from blue --to green --steps 5,25,60,100 --interval 300`

alex: Copy. I'll handle latency/5xx dashboards, will ping on anomalies.

sam: Quick q — how do we handle long-lived websockets / session affinity? We still need session pinning for 15m right?

ryan-sre: Yes, sessions need short pinning. Suggested guard: set `session.persistence=15m` and `stickiness=client_ip, cookie` during ramp. If websocket count > 1000 with error spikes, trigger immediate rollback.

maria: From product side — any end-user visible changes? Sounds like backend-only. Confirm no feature flags needed.

alex: Confirmed no FF. No schema changes. Low-risk from UX perspective.

sam: Adding router config snippet for the shift (for ops):
```yaml
# router traffic-split
routes:
  - name: default
    from: blue
    to: green
    weights: [5,25,60,100]
    session_persistence: 15m
    grace_seconds: 300
```

ryan-sre: Monitoring playbook (short):
- watch: infra.p95_latency (edge) and infra.p95_latency (eu-west)
- watch: infra.5xx_rate > 1%
- watch: router.queue_depth > baseline * 2
If any condition met for 2 consecutive minutes -> `@oncall` assess -> if confirmed, run `./routerctl set-weight --all blue=100` and notify #incidents.

infra-bot: Scheduled job created: router-shift-2475302468 (cron executor). Will post status updates at each step.

deploy-bot: Starting step 1 -> green=5% now. I'll post progress. If you see anomalies react with :eyes: and `rollback` in-thread. Good luck team.
